title: Entering a Multi-Lane Roundabout: You Must Yield to Circulating Vehicles in ALL Lanes (Both Inner & Outer Lanes!)

scene_match.note: Blue sedan stopped behind shark-teeth yield line while inner-lane red car and outer-lane silver SUV circulate, exactly the yield-to-both-lanes situation.

teaching_correct.note: Waiting behind yield line until both inner and outer circulating vehicles pass teaches the both-lanes yield rule with correct geometry.
